subject.title: fix(auto-reply): self-heal reply-session-init conflict instead of permanently wedging the session

question: Which open reply-session conflict self-heal PR should be the canonical landing path: this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: Both branches target the same session-state and message-delivery recovery path, and automation cannot safely choose between overlapping unmerged PRs while real conflict-recovery proof is still incomplete.

options.title: Consolidate On The Older Candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the canonical branch, require the same after-fix live conflict proof there, and close this PR only after that path is clearly viable or merged.

options.title: Sponsor This PR Instead
options.body: Ask this author to add real conflict-recovery proof and any missing stale-candidate/admission regression coverage, then close the older overlapping PR after this path is accepted.

options.title: Pause Both Until Proof
options.body: Keep both open but block merge until a maintainer or contributor provides live patched conflict-recovery evidence and identifies the branch to carry forward.

recommendation.title: Consolidate On The Older Candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the canonical branch, require the same after-fix live conflict proof there, and close this PR only after that path is clearly viable or merged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and merger history on the reply-session initialization guard makes this the strongest routing candidate for choosing the canonical session-state fix path.
